name: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. produces, imports, exports, sells, and leases submersible pumps, environmental equipment, and related machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally.
